Bug_Title: "@Controller" classes that use "@SessionAttributes" must call "setComplete" on their "SessionStatus" objects
Bug_Explanation: "@Controller" classes that use "@SessionAttributes" must call "setComplete" on their "SessionStatus" objects to ensure that session data is cleaned up properly after the session ends. The provided code does not call "setComplete()", resulting in potential data retention issues.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by the usage of @SessionAttributes without the corresponding setComplete call on a SessionStatus object in the HelloWorld class. The test simulates a session attribute scenario by invoking the showBug method, which indirectly calls the greet method, demonstrating that session cleanup is not handled.
